+"""Once a swimmer clears the three refusal rules, admission is a question
+of places, with the last one held back for a member.
+"""
+
+from lido import admit
+
+
+def make_session(kind="family", capacity=10, admitted=0):
+    return {"kind": kind, "capacity": capacity, "admitted": admitted}
+
+
+def make_swimmer(name="Ada", age=10, member=True, accompanied=True):
+    return {
+        "name": name,
+        "age": age,
+        "member": member,
+        "accompanied": accompanied,
+    }
+
+
+def test_member_admitted_with_only_one_place_free():
+    session = make_session(capacity=5, admitted=4)
+    swimmer = make_swimmer(member=True)
+    assert admit(session, swimmer) == "admitted"
+
+
+def test_non_member_waits_with_only_one_place_free():
+    session = make_session(capacity=5, admitted=4)
+    swimmer = make_swimmer(member=False)
+    assert admit(session, swimmer) == "waiting"
+
+
+def test_non_member_admitted_with_two_places_free():
+    session = make_session(capacity=5, admitted=3)
+    swimmer = make_swimmer(member=False)
+    assert admit(session, swimmer) == "admitted"
+
+
+def test_member_waits_when_session_is_full():
+    session = make_session(capacity=5, admitted=5)
+    swimmer = make_swimmer(member=True)
+    assert admit(session, swimmer) == "waiting"
+
+
+def test_non_member_waits_when_session_is_full():
+    session = make_session(capacity=5, admitted=5)
+    swimmer = make_swimmer(member=False)
+    assert admit(session, swimmer) == "waiting"
+
+
+def test_a_session_of_one_place_holds_it_for_a_member():
+    session = make_session(capacity=1, admitted=0)
+    swimmer = make_swimmer(member=True)
+    assert admit(session, swimmer) == "admitted"
+
+
+def test_a_session_of_one_place_makes_a_non_member_wait():
+    session = make_session(capacity=1, admitted=0)

+"""The three refusal rules, and that they are settled before places are
+counted.
+"""
+
+from lido import admit
+
+
+def make_session(kind="family", capacity=10, admitted=0):
+    return {"kind": kind, "capacity": capacity, "admitted": admitted}
+
+
+def make_swimmer(name="Ada", age=10, member=True, accompanied=True):
+    return {
+        "name": name,
+        "age": age,
+        "member": member,
+        "accompanied": accompanied,
+    }
+
+
+# -- club sessions are for members --
+
+
+def test_non_member_refused_at_club_session():
+    session = make_session(kind="club")
+    swimmer = make_swimmer(member=False)
+    assert admit(session, swimmer) == "refused"
+
+
+def test_non_member_refused_at_club_session_even_with_room_to_spare():
+    session = make_session(kind="club", capacity=100, admitted=0)
+    swimmer = make_swimmer(member=False)
+    assert admit(session, swimmer) == "refused"
+
+
+def test_member_not_refused_for_membership_at_club_session():
+    session = make_session(kind="club")
+    swimmer = make_swimmer(member=True)
+    assert admit(session, swimmer) == "admitted"
+
+
+# -- lane sessions are for swimmers 16 and over --
+
+
+def test_under_16_refused_at_lane_session():
+    session = make_session(kind="lane")
+    swimmer = make_swimmer(age=15)
+    assert admit(session, swimmer) == "refused"
+
+
+def test_16_is_old_enough_for_a_lane_session():
+    session = make_session(kind="lane", capacity=10, admitted=0)
+    swimmer = make_swimmer(age=16)
+    assert admit(session, swimmer) == "admitted"
+
+
+def test_lane_refusal_holds_even_when_the_session_is_full():
+    # If age weren't checked first, a full lane session would answer
+    # "waiting" instead of "refused" for an under-16.
+    session = make_session(kind="lane", capacity=5, admitted=5)
+    swimmer = make_swimmer(age=10)
+    assert admit(session, swimmer) == "refused"
+
+
+# -- under 8s must be accompanied, at any kind of session --
+
+
+def test_unaccompanied_under_8_refused_at_family_session():
+    session = make_session(kind="family")
+    swimmer = make_swimmer(age=7, accompanied=False)
+    assert admit(session, swimmer) == "refused"
+
+
+def test_unaccompanied_under_8_refused_at_club_session_even_as_a_member():
+    session = make_session(kind="club")
+    swimmer = make_swimmer(age=7, accompanied=False, member=True)
+    assert admit(session, swimmer) == "refused"
+
+
+def test_8_is_old_enough_to_go_in_alone():
+    session = make_session(kind="family", capacity=10, admitted=0)
+    swimmer = make_swimmer(age=8, accompanied=False)
+    assert admit(session, swimmer) == "admitted"
+
+
+def test_accompanied_under_8_is_not_refused_for_age():
+    session = make_session(kind="family", capacity=10, admitted=0)
+    swimmer = make_swimmer(age=3, accompanied=True)
+    assert admit(session, swimmer) == "admitted"
+
+
+def test_under_8_refusal_holds_even_when_the_session_is_empty():
+    session = make_session(kind="family", capacity=10, admitted=0)
+    swimmer = make_swimmer(age=2, accompanied=False)
+    assert admit(session, swimmer) == "refused"

+"""admit() raises ValueError before it decides anything, for bad inputs."""
+
+import pytest
+
+from lido import admit
+
+
+def make_session(kind="family", capacity=10, admitted=0):
+    return {"kind": kind, "capacity": capacity, "admitted": admitted}
+
+
+def make_swimmer(name="Ada", age=10, member=True, accompanied=True):
+    return {
+        "name": name,
+        "age": age,
+        "member": member,
+        "accompanied": accompanied,
+    }
+
+
+def test_unknown_kind_raises():
+    session = make_session(kind="disco")
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        admit(session, make_swimmer())
+
+
+def test_zero_capacity_raises():
+    session = make_session(capacity=0)
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        admit(session, make_swimmer())
+
+
+def test_negative_capacity_raises():
+    session = make_session(capacity=-1)
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        admit(session, make_swimmer())
+
+
+def test_negative_admitted_raises():
+    session = make_session(capacity=10, admitted=-1)
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        admit(session, make_swimmer())
+
+
+def test_admitted_over_capacity_raises():
+    session = make_session(capacity=5, admitted=6)
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        admit(session, make_swimmer())
+
+
+def test_admitted_equal_to_capacity_does_not_raise_for_session_reasons():
+    # A full session is a valid session; it just has no places left.
+    session = make_session(capacity=5, admitted=5)
+    assert admit(session, make_swimmer()) in ("admitted", "waiting", "refused")
+
+
+def test_negative_age_raises():
+    session = make_session()
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        admit(session, make_swimmer(age=-1))
+
+
+def test_session_is_checked_before_swimmer():
+    # An invalid session and an invalid swimmer are both present; the
+    # session is checked first, so its complaint is the one raised.
+    session = make_session(kind="disco")
+    swimmer = make_swimmer(age=-1)
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="disco"):
+        admit(session, swimmer)
+
+
+def test_invalid_session_raises_even_when_swimmer_would_otherwise_be_refused():
+    # A non-member at a club session would ordinarily just be refused, but
+    # a broken session is caught first.
+    session = make_session(kind="club", capacity=0)
+    swimmer = make_swimmer(member=False)
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        admit(session, swimmer)
+
+
+def test_zero_age_is_valid():
+    session = make_session()
+    swimmer = make_swimmer(age=0, accompanied=True)
+    assert admit(session, swimmer) == "admitted"

@@ -0,0 +1,112 @@
+"""roll_call() works a queue through admit(), one at a time, in order."""
+
+import pytest
+
+from lido import roll_call
+
+
+def make_session(kind="family", capacity=10, admitted=0):
+    return {"kind": kind, "capacity": capacity, "admitted": admitted}
+
+
+def make_swimmer(name="Ada", age=10, member=True, accompanied=True):
+    return {
+        "name": name,
+        "age": age,
+        "member": member,
+        "accompanied": accompanied,
+    }
+
+
+def test_empty_queue_gives_three_empty_lists():
+    session = make_session()
+    result = roll_call(session, [])
+    assert result == {"admitted": [], "waiting": [], "refused": []}
+
+
+def test_places_fill_up_as_the_queue_is_worked():
+    # All members, so the held-back-for-a-member rule doesn't come into it
+    # here — see test_admit_capacity.py for that.
+    session = make_session(kind="family", capacity=2, admitted=0)
+    swimmers = [
+        make_swimmer(name="Ada", member=True),
+        make_swimmer(name="Bea", member=True),
+        make_swimmer(name="Cai", member=True),
+    ]
+    result = roll_call(session, swimmers)
+    assert result["admitted"] == ["Ada", "Bea"]
+    assert result["waiting"] == ["Cai"]
+    assert result["refused"] == []
+
+
+def test_the_last_place_is_still_held_for_a_member_down_the_queue():
+    # One place, and a non-member is standing ahead of a member.
+    session = make_session(kind="family", capacity=1, admitted=0)
+    swimmers = [
+        make_swimmer(name="Ada", member=False),
+        make_swimmer(name="Bea", member=True),
+    ]
+    result = roll_call(session, swimmers)
+    assert result["waiting"] == ["Ada"]
+    assert result["admitted"] == ["Bea"]
+
+
+def test_waiting_and_refused_swimmers_take_no_place():
+    session = make_session(kind="lane", capacity=1, admitted=0)
+    swimmers = [
+        make_swimmer(name="Toddler", age=3, member=True),  # refused: age
+        make_swimmer(name="Ada", age=20, member=True),
+    ]
+    result = roll_call(session, swimmers)
+    assert result["refused"] == ["Toddler"]
+    # The refused toddler didn't eat the one free place.
+    assert result["admitted"] == ["Ada"]
+
+
+def test_names_appear_in_queue_order_within_each_list():
+    session = make_session(kind="family", capacity=10, admitted=0)
+    swimmers = [
+        make_swimmer(name="Cai", member=True),
+        make_swimmer(name="Ada", member=True),
+        make_swimmer(name="Bea", member=True),
+    ]
+    result = roll_call(session, swimmers)
+    assert result["admitted"] == ["Cai", "Ada", "Bea"]
+
+
+def test_session_mapping_is_left_unchanged():
+    session = make_session(kind="family", capacity=5, admitted=2)
+    original = dict(session)
+    swimmers = [make_swimmer(name="Ada"), make_swimmer(name="Bea")]
+    roll_call(session, swimmers)
+    assert session == original
+    assert session["admitted"] == 2
+
+
+def test_value_error_from_admit_propagates_out():
+    session = make_session(kind="family", capacity=5, admitted=0)
+    swimmers = [make_swimmer(name="Ada", age=-1)]
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        roll_call(session, swimmers)
+
+
+def test_invalid_session_raises_before_any_swimmer_is_judged():
+    session = make_session(kind="disco")
+    swimmers = [make_swimmer(name="Ada")]
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        roll_call(session, swimmers)
+
+
+def test_mixed_outcomes_land_in_the_right_lists():
+    session = make_session(kind="club", capacity=1, admitted=0)
+    swimmers = [
+        make_swimmer(name="Guest", member=False),  # refused: not a member
+        make_swimmer(name="Member", member=True),  # admitted: takes the place
+        make_swimmer(name="Latecomer", member=True),  # waiting: no places left
+    ]
+    result = roll_call(session, swimmers)
+    assert result == {
+        "admitted": ["Member"],
+        "waiting": ["Latecomer"],
+        "refused": ["Guest"],
+    }

+"""set_bill: every word is set, in the order it was written."""
+
+import playbill
+
+
+def _words_of(lines):
+    """The words carried by a set of lines, in the order they appear."""
+    return " ".join(lines).split()
+
+
+def test_every_word_survives_at_a_generous_measure():
+    words = ["the", "curtain", "rises", "at", "eight"]
+    lines = playbill.set_bill(" ".join(words), 200)
+    assert _words_of(lines) == words
+
+
+def test_word_order_survives_a_tight_measure():
+    words = ["romeo", "and", "juliet", "a", "tragedy", "in", "five", "acts"]
+    lines = playbill.set_bill(" ".join(words), 6)
+    assert _words_of(lines) == words
+
+
+def test_word_order_survives_with_a_word_wider_than_the_measure():
+    words = ["short", "extraordinarily-long-word", "short", "again"]
+    lines = playbill.set_bill(" ".join(words), 8)
+    assert _words_of(lines) == words
+
+
+def test_word_order_survives_odd_whitespace_between_words():
+    text = "alpha\n\tbeta   gamma\ndelta"
+    lines = playbill.set_bill(text, 5)
+    assert _words_of(lines) == ["alpha", "beta", "gamma", "delta"]
